scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be the only child in the family
Applicant must have secured at least 55% marks or equivalent in the qualifying examination
Applicant must not have previously received this scholarship or any other award under the scheme
Applicant must not change the course of study or the institute after the award is granted
Orphan candidates supported by a guardian are exempt from the income criteria
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fees, USD 15,400 annual maintenance allowance, USD 1,532 contingency allowance, visa fee, medical insurance, air passage and other travel expenses for postgraduate studies abroad.
